evidence: ZTO ﬁlms were deposited on thermally grown 200-nm-thick SiO2/Si, bare Si, and quartz substrates by PEALD in growth temperature range of 100–200 ◦C under a working pressure of 3 Torr. Ar gas was used as both the carrier gas for Sn precursor pulses and the purge gas with a ﬂow rate of 80 sccm.
